description: Use when the user asks what to eat somewhere or where to find a dish: 'what should I eat in Naples?', 'where to get pastel de nata in Lisbon', 'local dishes in Hanoi'. Signature dishes of a city and where to eat them (read-only). Each item has a description, the venues resolved to ids and page URLs, and the page to cite; ranked by editorial score.

city.description: City slug or name, e.g. 'new-york-city' or 'New York City'. Unknown cities answer with did_you_mean.
city.title: City

country.description: Country slug or name, e.g. 'italy'. Optional where city is given.
country.title: Country

limit.description: Maximum results (1-100; at most 20 without an API key).
limit.title: Limit

query.description: Free text: a dish, ingredient, style or grape.
query.title: Query

name: dishes
title: Signature dishes of a city
